name: faf001_GetProcesses
description: Read one page of caller-accessible process instances, optionally filtered by status. This Action does not modify data.

CustomAPIRequestParameters.name: faf001_GetProcesses.faf001_Status
CustomAPIRequestParameters.description: Optional integer BP Instance Status choice value, not the built-in state or status reason. Omit to include all statuses.

CustomAPIRequestParameters.name: faf001_GetProcesses.faf001_PageSize
CustomAPIRequestParameters.description: Optional integer from 1 to 500. Defaults to 100. Repeat the same effective size on subsequent pages.

CustomAPIRequestParameters.name: faf001_GetProcesses.faf001_ContinuationToken
CustomAPIRequestParameters.description: Opaque token from the previous GetProcesses response. Repeat the same status filter. Omit or send an empty string to start.

CustomAPIResponseProperties.name: faf001_GetProcesses.faf001_Processes
CustomAPIResponseProperties.description: One page of caller-accessible faf001_bpinstance rows. Does not include child records.

CustomAPIResponseProperties.name: faf001_GetProcesses.faf001_HasMore
CustomAPIResponseProperties.description: True when Dataverse reports another page. Paging is not a point-in-time snapshot.

CustomAPIResponseProperties.name: faf001_GetProcesses.faf001_NextToken
CustomAPIResponseProperties.description: Continuation token for the next request, or an empty string on the last page.
